name: crashlens
description: A portfolio-ready error monitoring platform with a browser SDK, Express API, and Next.js dashboard.

scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && concurrently --kill-others --names API,DASHBOARD,SHOP --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @crashlens/api" "npm run dev --workspace @crashlens/dashboard" "npm run dev --workspace @crashlens/demo-shop"
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @crashlens/api && npm run build --workspace @crashlens/dashboard && npm run build --workspace @crashlens/demo-shop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
